extracted.name: THE Chocolate Chip Cookie
extracted.description: Extremely rich flavor. Would be milk’s favorite cookie if that phrase wasn’t copyrighted…
ingredient_lines: 225 g chocolate roughly chopped. Use a 50-50 split of 60% coacao and white chocolate for your chocolate mix (1 bar each chocolate type)
instruction_lines: Measure out all of your ingredients wet and dry and put them in small bowls
Put the butter in a pan and set heat to medium / high
Constantly mix butter over a medium to low flame while lightly bubbling until it reaches a golden brown color
Pour browned butter into mixing bowl with both sugars
Cream together sugar butter and sugar until incorporated
Add whole egg and the 2 yolks and mix on medium until incorporated
Add flour, salt and baking soda
Mix in chocolate chunks and walnuts
Use an XL scoop to put 5 to 6 leveled portions onto a parchment lined baking sheet
Bake 350 for 10-15 mins on middle rack. Time depends on size of dough scoop
Take out of baking sheet using the parchment paper and let cool completely on wire rack
